snippet.title: Pack my Order — Official Game Trailer (Cozy Puzzle Simulator)
snippet.description:
Official trailer for "Pack my Order" — a cozy, meditative online shopping puzzle simulator designed to help you unwind and clear your mind! ✨🛒

No timers, no rush, no stress. Just you, a shopping list, and the aesthetic satisfaction of a perfectly filled grocery cart. Read your customers' unique wishes, explore various catalog categories (from fresh bakery to sweet snacks), manage their budget in real-time, and double-check the final receipt to complete the order!

🎮 Play the Free Demo & Add to wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4388420/Pack_my_Order/
🚀 Coming August 5, 2026!
🌟 Explore our full collection: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45978844

Game Features:
🍎 Smart Shopping: Decode clever customer requests, budgets, and hidden preferences;
🥐 Rich Catalog: Switch between grocery categories just like in a real online supermarket;
📊 Total Cart Control: Easily adjust quantities, remove items, and track the bill;
🎨 Relax Mode: Enjoy free shopping with a massive budget just for pure visual pleasure;
💖 Anti-Stress ASMR: Charming animations, soft colors, and satisfying interface sounds.

Subscribe for more updates, trailers, and upcoming cozy releases!
📬 Contact us: owlshowls.steam@gmail.com
